metadata.description: NextWork's open-source video plugins: measure how a short-form creator edits, then edit your own talking-head video in that style.

plugins.name: creator-teardown
plugins.description: Break down any short-form creator's videos: view counts, word-level transcripts, measured pace, cuts, zooms and caption style.

plugins.name: ai-editor
plugins.description: Edit your own talking-head video in a creator's measured style: retakes and pauses cut, then zooms, captions and cards rendered with Remotion on your laptop or AWS Lambda.
